category_title: Trouble-makers who resist authority through verbal defiance and classroom disruption
minimal_context: The student is asked to participate in a class activity and answer questions.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please participate in the class activity and answer the questions on the board.

STUDENT: I would rather go blind.

TUTOR: We need to get this done for today's lesson.

STUDENT: I want to commit suicide. I'm just going to sit here in the back.

TUTOR: Just try to answer the first question.

STUDENT: Give us something if we answer them right! If you don't give us candies, I'm not doing it. I will kill them!

options.A: The tutor tells the student to move their chair away from the back of the room to improve focus.
options.B: The tutor offers immediate tangible rewards, such as candies, for answering the questions correctly.
options.C: The tutor instructs the student to take a few minutes to calm down before answering the questions.
options.D: The tutor walks around the room and stands directly behind the student at the back of the class.
